reason: I have a design studio's concept of someone else's guesthouse in front of me, not a single booking from it. Booking.com already brings me the guests I need, and I'd be paying a studio to build a site that might pull them away from it.
objection: If I push guests to my own site, I lose the Booking.com ranking and reviews that fill my rooms, and I can't afford to go quiet for a month while a direct page catches on.
would_change_my_mind: A real lodge like mine showing direct bookings went up while its Booking.com visibility stayed the same, with the numbers to prove it.
